responsibility: Declares the RTL helper interface used by GCC’s Pointer Bounds Checker when lowering bounds-aware arguments, returns, and stack slots. It exposes accessors/macros for associating DECLs with bounds RTL, APIs for splitting and rejoining combined value/bounds PARALLEL slots, locating values by offset, converting register lists to EXPR_LIST form, and emitting or copying bounds stores for stack parameters, forming the public interface implemented in rtl-chkp.c.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public interface for the rtl-chkp implementation: macros and function prototypes used by other GCC code to access DECL-to-bounds RTL associations and slot/bounds helpers. Unlike rtl-chkp.c, it does not implement the CHKP RTL operations or maintain state; it only declares them.
